title: The Lost Isles
imageAlt: The Floating Island of Ordega landscape plot
paragraphs: The Island of Ordega was the largest floating island in all of Nevera. It was held in place by six large chains which were given the name of the six gods of Bala: Toro, Maleika, and Aska for the east chains, and Gabel, Honok, and Cocha for the West chains.

The city that laid on the island's rocky surface was called the city of Tudok, named after its founder over two thousand years ago. With a population of twenty thousand demi-humans and one million humans.
